title: Launch tally scratchpad — morning to post-launch
content:
2026-03-12 morning brain dump / running log

Top intent for today: get PRD edits locked + confirm rollout signals and guardrails before canary open. Keep list short and pragmatic.

MORNING PRIORITIES (quick)
- finalize PRD section: "runtime fallbacks" (see paragraph 4 — reword for clarity) — note: remove sentence that implies automatic model replacement without customer opt-in.
- confirm canary plan with infra: target 10% traffic across us-west1 for first 2 hours, fallback to 1.1 if error spike >3%
- reach out to legal about logging retention for Private customers (KMS audit note)
- quick sync with SRE on alert tiers and runbooks

PRD EDITS (live notes)
- edit intro: shorten description of Dedicated — emphasize reserved throughput not machine type.
- runtime fallbacks: add bullet: "manual opt-out for enterprise customers + audit log" (Lucia to review).
- rollout table: change canary window from 30m -> 2h per infra rec. Add metric column: error-rate, 95p95 latency, cost delta.
- add small FAQ blurb: "What happens if model variant unavailable?" -> fallback to nearest compatible quantized variant OR queue/buffer with Xs grace. TODO: pick wording with SRE.

QUESTIONS / DECISIONS PENDING
- Q1: Are we comfortable with automatic fallback to lower-quality model for non-enterprise? (pros/cost vs. user-facing quality). Talk to Marco (research) by EOD.
- Q2: Logging retention policy for Private customers — legal needs clarification: 90d vs customer-controlled. Tag Legal thread #legal-privacy.
- Q3: Should we include a preflight check in the Console to warn if model clients pinned to older version? (Might block some customers). Jira: PROD-1234 assigned to Jared.

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS
- Jared: confirm infra ability to limit canary to us-west1 and throttle (ask for runbook alpha).
- Lucia: copy-edit PRD runtime bullets + check phrasing on audit logs.
- SRE (Priya): confirm alert thresholds + runbook owner for high-latency incidents (pager rota impacts).
- Sales: quick one-pager for early access customers explaining potential quality vs. cost tradeoffs — handoff to Mariana.

LAUNCH CHECKLIST (short form)
[ ] PRD finalized and linked in Confluence (PRD-742)
[ ] Canary deployment config uploaded to infra repo (PR #981)
[ ] Runbooks updated & reviewed by SRE (owner + escalation path)
[ ] Telemetry dashboards created (latency, error, token-cost) + alerting thresholds
[ ] Customer communication draft for early access participants
[ ] Legal sign-off on logging and retention
[ ] Ops on-call confirmed for first 24h post-rollout

STATUS UPDATES (rolling)
- PRD: 70% edits in, need final pass (afternoon).
- Infra PR: opened, awaiting review from infra-team (link above).
- Dashboards: Kept minimal for day1 — prioritize error-rate and 95p95 latency.
- Legal: pinged (via Slack), reply expected today.

POST-LAUNCH GAUGE / MONITORING (notes for runbook)
- Primary signals: request success rate (1m/5m windows), p95/p99 latency, token-per-request cost delta.
- Secondary: queue length, model swapping count, KV cache hit rate.
- Escalation flow: if error rate > 2% sustained for 5m -> auto rollback + page SRE -> notify product lead.
- Observable tags: route, model-variant, region, customer-tier.

QUICK REMINDERS / PERSONAL TODOS
- 10:30 AM — 1:1 with Jared: confirm rollout percent and gating tickets.
- 11:15 AM — drop note to Marco about fallback quality tradeoff (two-sentence ask).
- 4:00 PM — review SRE runbook edits and close PRD.
- End-of-day: publish short summary to #product-launch channel with links.

SCRATCH THOUGHTS (half-formed)
- Could we add a lightweight "preview mode" toggle in Console so customers can test a model variant with their traffic slice? Might help adoption but adds UI complexity.
- Consider a "soft-fallback" that returns a friendly warning in response when lower-quality variant used — helps user expectation.

SLACK LINKS / TICKETS (for quick copy)
- legal-privacy thread (Slack) -> pinged @Elena
- Jira: PROD-1234 (canary gating)
- Confluence: PRD-742
- Infra PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/981

END OF RUN (snapshot) 2026-03-12 09:05 — keep updating this file as things move.

NOTES TO SELF
- When wording PRD fallback section, avoid absolutes: use "recommended"/"default" language, call out enterprise opt-in.
- Don't bake in exact hardware types in PRD; keep at abstraction of "reserved GPU capacity".

---
Random micro-tasks (log as they come):
- email ops to confirm on-call names (sent)
- drop sample customer note to Mariana (DRAFT saved in Gmail)
- check commit history on infra PR to ensure migration scripts included
